in_latin.name: Gwendolinus
in_latin.meaning: Name derived from Welsh origin, possibly related to white ring or fair-browed
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen derivatum ex origine Cambriana, forte connectum ad anulum albam vel frontem candidam. In traditione Christiana, nomen hoc potest referri ad virtutem, innocentiam, et candorem mentis. In scriptura Latina, nomen Gwendolinus potest esse significativum fortitudinis et perseverantiae in fide Christiana.
